verdict.rationale: Granola documents an official MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to meeting notes for querying notes, searching transcripts, and finding past topics. A community user independently confirms the MCP takes a couple of clicks to set up with Claude/ChatGPT. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the exposed MCP tool list and the authentication/permission model for the MCP connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to your Granola meeting notes via MCP. Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.
Connect your AI tools to your Granola meeting notes with Granola MCP. Once connected you can use this to: search through your meeting notes, find specific topics discussed in past meetings
